newsitem.title: USA: AccuStaff to increases credit facility.
newsitem.headline: AccuStaff to increases credit facility.

text.p: AccuStaff Inc on Wednesday said that it increased its revolving unsecured credit facility from to $500 million from $150 million.
The facility is underwritten and syndicated by NationsBank Corp. Included in the syndicate of 20 banks are 10 domestic banks and 10 foreign banks, AccuStaff said.

In a statement, AccuStaff President and Chief Executive Derek Dewan said, "We will continue to use leverage appropriately while maintaining an optimal debt to capitalization ratio. Of the $500 million, approximately $400 million remains and is available to continue the implementation of our growth strategy."
AccuStaff is a national provider of business services, including consulting, outsourcing, training, and strategic staffing services.
